arguments.descriptor: Whole receptor-lemma-family-v2, descriptor ID recomputed with original canonical ASCII preimage excluding family_id/provenance. No substitution/environment accepted. Full typed descriptor/admission still required independently.

layout_shape.inputs: Ordered root input port ID strings.
layout_shape.nodes: Ordered exact flat nodes each {id,rule,ordered_inputs,origin}; origin exact {family_id,call_path,step_id,hypothesis_port,gamma_index}. Same shape returned by provider7._layout; no origin formula/witness/substitution included.

limits.override: Only positive exact integer reductions of known caps.

row_assignment.node_rows: [[flatID, literal-int-row],...] every exact flat node once
row_assignment.range: 0<=row<24; bool is not int. Every ordered read strictly prior.

arguments.tick: Owned native tick supplied later by Root; every callback exception propagated unchanged. No tick executed during Source authoring.

downstream: Fresh complete observed matching/expansion, independent4358, original primitive membership, marked full union4bd6, full offered/engine-exposure census and ordinary fallback remain mandatory. No provider/engine/caller integration performed.

errors.PlanHeadError: ValueError subclass with literal code; invalid data/protocol, not HEAD_CONFLICT or learned negative.
errors.callback: Every BaseException from tick wrapped only to preserve identity across own-prefix catch then re-raised; never counted negative/UNKNOWN.
errors.other_errors: Propagate. No native/checker call exists in this module.

formula_heads.absent: A root formula_meta assigns no mark, independent of every source/current substitution. No unrecognized tag is silently treated as known.
formula_heads.conditional: Known head invariance is conditional on later valid typed/capture-safe instantiation; the gate is not full descriptor/host membership validation.

output.HEAD_CONFLICT: Only after complete supported structural validation; unequal known values at same [5,row]; reject THIS proposed advisory layout only.
output.NO_KNOWN_HEAD_CONFLICT: Pass-through, possibly all absent. No compatibility/proof/native union/coverage claim.
output.UNKNOWN: Unsupported form or own finite resource prefix; no partial requirements/conflicts/negative authority returned.

planning_marks.absence: mark:null on unknown requirement, no assigned zero or wildcard value.
planning_marks.requirements: Ordered root input interfaces, each primitive output then each repeated ordered premise read, exposed output interfaces. Full descriptor template_path/source/point retained.
planning_marks.union: known_marks retains all per-point head groups; multiple values are a conflict, never silently merged into a valid state. Root interfaces are planning formula-equality obligations; unused input ports are not claimed to insert native marks.

signature: check_plan_heads(*, descriptor, layout_shape, row_assignment, tick, limits=None)
supported_scope: Primitive-only deps[] and root hypotheses[]; origin maps each flat node to unique exact root body step_id, with empty call_path and no hypothesis_port. Never zip by position. CALL/dependencies/materialized hypotheses return UNKNOWN/pass-through, not conflict.
